info.title: Research Funding & Innovation Intelligence Platform
info.description: REST API for funding discovery, research/patent/technology intelligence, weighted innovation scoring, commercialization recommendations, alerts, reports and administration. Use **Authorize** with a platform account (OAuth2 password flow) to try protected endpoints.
